summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of Rutuja Dignity Doll campaign microsite. All 14 requested features verified as working across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: FormKit.jsx: submit reset() has eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps; acceptable but note initial object is recreated each render (minor).
FAQ has 11 triggers (faq-trigger-0..10); spec asked for 0..9, so extra trigger 10 exists (not a bug, extra content is fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only. All routes (/, /request-workshop, /donate, /partner, /contact) load without console/page errors. Verified: hero CTAs, all 12 sections, FAQ accordion open/close, EN<->HI language toggle changes headline + nav labels, all 3 forms show required errors on empty submit, email regex works, submit triggers loading and ~900ms success state (workshop-success, contact-success, partner-success visible). Donate page shows [DONATION MECHANISM TO BE CONNECTED] placeholder and has no fake payment/checkout. Mobile 390px: hamburger opens mobile-menu, mobile-cta-bar with donate/workshop visible, no horizontal overflow on any page (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 everywhere). Submit button on workshop form is not overlapped by fixed CTA bar. Zero console errors on all pages tested.
